title: Shot
description: A single shot within a Scene. Produced incrementally by Shot Planner -> Camera Engine -> Motion Engine -> Lighting Engine -> Style Engine, in that order. This is the unit of work that the Render Configuration Compiler turns into one RenderSpec.

description.description: Plain-language creative description of what happens in this shot, written by the Scene Analyzer / AI Director.

style_override.description: Optional per-shot override; unset fields inherit from the DirectorPlan's global style.

storyboard_frame_id.description: Reference to the corresponding Storyboard frame, once generated.

asset_references.description: Asset ids used as conditioning input (e.g. for image-to-video).
